Building my bridal trousseau just got a lot more special with the Victoria’s Secret Bridal Experience. 👰🏻‍♀️💕

If you’re a bride-to-be, this is definitely
ads.transcript: If you're getting married, stop strolling. You need to know about this. Victoria's Secret has created the most beautiful bridal experience and I'm so glad that I got to experience as I built my trousseau for my big day. You get your personal bridal expert who helps you to curate everything that you need for your wedding, honeymoon and moments in between. And it's not just about lingerie. You can also pick up beautiful sleepwear which you can actually get customized for yourself. beauty, fragrances, gifting, all those little honeymoon essentials. And before choosing the right bra for your trousseau, it is so crucial to get a bra fit done by the bra fit expert to know your right size and trust me, that makes a lot of difference. And you know what? Everything just felt so personal. You're guided through the whole experience based on what you want. And then my favorite part, my very own Victoria's Secret trousseau box. everything I selected packed in a beautiful trousseau trunk for me to take home. A keepsake all of us bride would cherish. Making the whole experience feel even more special. Because when you are busy planning everything for your big day, the bride deserves to feel celebrated too.

ads.transcript: Everyone will tell you about the lehenga, jewellery and shoes you need when you're getting married. But nobody will give you a list for everything that goes underneath it. First, get properly fitted before you start buying lingerie for the wedding. The bra you need under a blouse, a fitted dress and your everyday clothes are three completely different requirements. Also, your getting ready outfit deserves some thought because this is what you'll actually be photographed in before the wedding. you can personalise these for yourself or your bridesmaids, from the embroidery to the font and the thread colour. And please pick something you can take off without pulling it over finished hair and makeup. Don't build your entire bridal lingerie drawer only for one night. You need the pretty pieces, obviously, but you also need things you'll actually wear after the wedding. Then make a separate honeymoon pile because otherwise these are exactly things you'll remember at 11pm the night before your flight. You can build your entire trousseau in one place. From lingerie to sleepwear, fragrances and all the little pieces you need around the wedding. It's basically a 360 degree bridal trousseau experience where you can choose everything and have it all brought together for you. We came here to make you the perfect checklist but realise that Victoria's Secret had already thought of everything. Save this for when you start building your bridal trousseau.

posts.transcript: I see you. Adjusting your bra strap again? Ah, got you again. This is the second episode of Take It Off Your Chest by Enamor where I will tell you how to wear your bra right. Okay, first off, I didn't even know you were supposed to measure yourself every year and I haven't since 10th class. So if you're like me, don't worry, I've got you. You just have to take two quick measurements. First is of your underbust and the next is of the fullest part of your bust. Once you have the correct measurement, check it on the size chart and you're good to go. Now that you know what's your right size, let's find the right way to wear your bra. When you're done putting on the bra, lean forward. This helps your bust settle into the cuffs properly and they're not stuck in the underwires. Now check the band. If it is riding up in the back, it won't support you properly. This means that you actually need to size down in the band and up in the cuff. Keep it straight, that is where the real comfort lies. And please stop tightening your straps until they dig in. If you cannot slide two fingers comfortably, then they're too tight. See, no lumps, no digging, just a clean silhouette. And that is how you do it girls.
